recipes.name: Simple Creamy Lemon Chicken Sauce
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Stir chicken soup, water, lemon juice, butter, and garlic powder together in a pan and place over medium heat. Cook until hot, about 5 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Simple Creamy Lemon Chicken Sauce
raw_recipe.description: This simple sauce is made of cream of chicken soup mixed with lemon juice, garlic, and spices. It tastes great on rice, pasta, chicken, or veggies.
raw_recipe.name: Simple Creamy Lemon Chicken Sauce
recipeIngredient: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Stir chicken soup, water, lemon juice, butter, and garlic powder together in a pan and place over medium heat. Cook until hot, about 5 minutes.

review.reviewBody: Really good! I seasoned chicken breasts with sea salt/pepper/garlic powder. Browned them in olive oil/garlic for 5 minutes on both sides then transferred to the oven at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. While they baked I used the ingredients for the sauce plus a dash of italian seasoning. I added all of this to the left over olive oil/garlic from browning the chicken. It turned out great! I served my chicken and sauce over leftover rotini plus pasta and my husbands over leftover rice. Great easy meal that I think my kids will eat and will always have the ingredients on hand! Thanks!

I needed a seriously budget dinner idea, and had a package of potato gnocchi to work with that seemed a good match--and was. I used about 1/2 teaspoon of minced garlic instead of powder. I also added about 1/2 can spinach (canned, no less--seriously budget night) for health and flavor, an additional tablespoon of lemon juice and about a tablespoon of basil paste. I didn't have enough butter, and wanted to reduce the cholesterol anyway so I used olive oil instead. Sauteed the gnocchi in olive oil and a little butter with ground sage and a smidge of minced garlic. Who said you can't make real dinner magic at the dollar store? lol

I made this tonight with chicken tenderlions...its was pretty good. I added 2 cans with about 1/4c of half and half instead of water, half of a large lemon juice, & lemon zest. Browned my tenderlions after they marinated over night in olive oil, garlic powder, & thyme, added the sauce and let simmer for about 5-10 min. Turned out really nice....this is a keeper! =)

I have used this recipe many times and I was just asked to make it again! It has a wonderful flavor. I used 2 Tbs. of dried cilantro in mine. I put this sauce over washed chicken (leave on most of water), coat with flour, then rub with chili powder. You put half of an inch of oil in the bottom of a frying pan until it is bubbly. you fry the chicken for 4-7 min on each side. Pour the sauce over and it is amazing. Tip: put your chicken between 2 pieces of saran wrap and hammer it down so it cooks evenly

I cut up chicken cutlets seasoned salt/pepper/garlic powder. Browned them in olive oil for 20 minutes. In another sauce pan, I used all the ingredients for the sauce. Once chicken is done. I placed the chicken in the sauce and simmered for about 10 minutes then served it over rice. Loved it!

Yummy and easy. I had breaded cutlets/small pieces of chicken and cooked that in large pan. Then put the cooked chicken in the oven to keep warm and made this sauce by deglazing the pan with about 1/4 of white wine and the ingredients listed here, but I skipped the butter and added dried thyme. Super easy and delicious over chicken, rice and broccoli.

mad for dinner last night, kids ate it right up. folled other recommendations, by adding dry white wine, one glove of garlic,some fresh basil, substituted the water for half and half and upped the lemon juice to 1/4c. served over fettuccini, chicken and a california meddley. yum!!
It was easy and delish. I Grilled the chicken , added spinach and mixed all together. Poured over rigatoni.and baked it.Very simple. Everyone loved it. A great winter dish.

This is a super good, easy recipe. My daughter is continually asking for chicken and rice, and there's only so many times you can do that before you never want to see chicken again. I have resorted to finding many many ways to make my chicken so everyone in my house is happy. I do have to say that this is one of our favorites. What I do is, cut chicken breasts into bite size pieces and sprinkle with lemon pepper. Then I brown them in a little oil along with diced onion. When the chicken is cooked I add the sauce ingredients (doubling, but we like ours extra saucy) I then let the mixture simmer until it is bubbly and serve it over rice. Thanks for the idea!!!

Great base for a sauce. I added lemon zest, some fresh thyme, a little dry white wine and some freshly ground pepper. I roasted some boneless, skinless chicken breasts that I had seasoned with salt, pepper, thyme, rosemary, and olive oil. Used this sauce over the breasts. Wonderful way to keep them tasty and moist for a crowd.

This was lovely. I served this mixed into spaghetti, with a little grated parmesan on top. The only changes i made were adding a little italian seasoning like many have suggested, and also a tsp of sugar in order to battle the sharpness of the lemon. Rather nice!
Instead of garlic, I seasoned with different spices, added a bit of salt and pepper as well
I hated it and my husband went without dinner because I made this. This is an expensive waste of items that would have been much better without this sauce. Don’t waste your chicken this way....

My husband loves lemony dishes. Although he dislikes milk and dairy items. The thought of making a lemon sauce and having to use heavy creams would not go over well. He eats vegetarian meals six days of the week. So, I came across this recipe and it went over really well. I did add a little more lemon juice. He loves this lemon sauce recipe on several different dishes. 
its quick and easy to make. Love it.
Needs more lemon.
Super yummy! I put my chicken over a bed of rice and it’s a perfect meal
Great base for a delicious, versatile sauce!

Wow! for the little amount of effort it took for this recipe, this is amazing! I just grilled chicken, microwaved frozen broccoli and poured the sauce on top. Will definitely be making this again soon!
Definitely simple, and tastes good! I made it exactly like the recipe says, and then baked a piece of chicken in it and had it over rice. It was so good, I couldn't stop eating it!
I always add extra lemon!
